visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a white knit sweater and a fuzzy headband, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit retail store. She holds several black ETVOS cosmetic compacts in her hands, showing them to the viewer. Behind her, shelves are stocked with various beauty products, and a blurred person in a green shirt is visible in the background. (2) A transition graphic appears on screen, featuring a minimalist white background with the logo 'ETVOS luscious skin series' centered in black text. The lighting is flat and professional, typical of a brand title card used for product introduction. (3) The camera cuts to a second woman with dark hair wearing an olive green shirt standing in the store aisle. A hand from off-camera, belonging to the first woman, holds a small black object toward the second woman as if conducting an interview. The background displays rows of white skincare bottles on glass shelves. (4) The first woman returns to a close-up shot, gesturing excitedly with her hands near her face. Her expressions are highly animated, with wide eyes and a broad smile, conveying enthusiasm about the makeup texture. (5) Multiple extreme close-up shots of the first woman's face are shown, focusing on the area around her nose, eyes, and cheeks. The lighting is bright, highlighting the fine texture of her skin and the application of foundation and powder. (6) A panning shot moves across the retail shelves, showcasing a wide variety of ETVOS products including tubes, bottles, and palettes organized neatly under warm shelf lighting. (7) The first woman is shown again in a medium shot, holding a product box and touching her ear to show off her earring while she continues her fast-paced talking. The store environment remains busy but orderly in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin speech begins immediately with a bright, friendly tone and high pitch variability. An upbeat electronic pop background music track with a steady synthesizer beat and electronic drums is present. A sharp 'pop' sound effect punctuates the first visual transition. (2) Vocal switches to a different female voice during an interview-style segment. The second speaker has a slightly lower, more conversational pitch but remains positive. A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the camera angle shifts. (3) The first female voice returns with even higher arousal and excitement, speaking rapidly about product benefits. A series of 'ding' sound effects trigger each time a variety-style text caption appears on screen. (4) The background music continues consistently throughout, providing a high-tempo rhythmic bed. Occasional cartoon-style slide whistle sounds emphasize humorous facial expressions. (5) The mix remains clean with the primary vocals standing clearly above the music. Small incidental rustling noises from handling product compacts are audible but minimal. The video concludes with a final cheerful phrase and a soft percussive impact SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle beauty vlog and endorsement for ETVOS mineral makeup. It utilizes a colleague's testimony and a first-person review to highlight the natural ingredients and skin-friendly properties of the brand, aimed at a female audience interested in cosmetics that do not require heavy makeup removal.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features multiple ETVOS brand logos, product close-ups, and a dedicated narration about why the speaker switched all her makeup to this specific brand.
